text:
Sasha: FYI — EU (eu-west-1) JIT keystore proxy canary started spiking outbound to audit-exporter (exporter.prod.eu-west). NAT QPS is saturated, GPU onboarding warm-pool is stalling.
Mira: saw the incident alert. when did it begin? :eyes:
Sasha: canary kicked at 08:03 UTC. ~220 nodes tried to join, each node did ~8 keystore fetches during startup. exporter QPS jumped to ~3k and NAT connections hit the soft limit.
Raj: that pattern explains warm-pool fill dropping and join timeouts. proxy issues — it does per-session fetches and bypassed node-side cache.
Lee: do we know why cache was bypassed?
Sasha: new client library defaulted to cache=false to avoid stale keys after rotation. rotation is rare; for warmup we can be conservative and TTL cache.
Mira: short-term mitigations: rollback the canary, flip the client-lib flag to allow a 30s cache, add sampling for audit events (1/10), or open an EU-only allowlist for the exporter to avoid the shared NAT queue.
Raj: propose flip flag + sampling first. smaller blast radius. I'll also open a temporary SG allowlist to the exporter CIDR as backup.
Ops-bot: runbook task created: /runbooks/keystore-eject-2025-01
Sasha: PR #4821 ready: set cache_ttl=30s for warmup flow and audit_sample_rate=0.1. tiny change, unit-tested in staging.
Lee: deploy EU canary only, gate with smoke tests (keystore.qps and warmpool.join_rate). ETA 8m.
Raj: temporary SG command (will revoke in 2h):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.32.0.0/22
```
Mira: also add a short buffering shim on the exporter: batch writes to S3 every 10s to reduce write QPS.
Infra-bot: provisional billing spike: extra egress from eu-west ~ 310GB -> est $22 (cloud line-item pending).
Sasha: dashboards updated: keystore.qps, natgw.conn, egress.bytes, warmpool.join_rate. lowered alert thresholds by ~30% while we monitor.
Lee: canary rolling now, watching keystore qps and failed-joins.
Mira: if canary confirms, we'll add an infra-safety policy: default 30s cache for JIT proxy warmup + mandatory sampling for high-cardinality flows, and an RFC to eng-platform docs.
Raj: capture cost delta and include in postmortem. tagging infra-billing for final numbers.
Infra-bot: noted, final invoicing may vary.
Sasha: thanks all, keeping eyes on EU pool.
Mira: :thumbsup:
